settings.appName.label: Application name
settings.appName.description: Shown in the navigation, the mobile header and the boot screen, and used as the browser tab suffix unless a document title overrides it.
settings.documentTitle.label: Document title
settings.documentTitle.description: Browser tab suffix, when it should differ from the application name. Empty uses the name.
settings.brandingDescription.label: Description
settings.brandingDescription.description: Description of the document and of a shared link. Empty uses the application shell description.
settings.ogImageUrl.label: Link preview image
settings.ogImageUrl.description: Image a shared link previews with. An address on this deployment, such as /og.png, or an https URL.
settings.faviconUrl.label: Browser icon
settings.faviconUrl.description: Icon of the browser tab. An address on this deployment, such as /favicon.svg, or an https URL.
settings.themeColor.label: Theme colour
settings.themeColor.description: Colour a mobile browser paints its chrome with, as a six-digit hex value such as #141B2E.
settings.logoUrl.label: Logo
settings.logoUrl.description: Image shown instead of the built-in mark in the navigation. An address on this deployment or an https URL; empty keeps the built-in mark.
